answer: Bounded trust-flow resists sybils: model attestations as a flow network from a trusted vault of seed identities, capping the trust that may cross any single edge. The honest region can push only a bounded total into a sybil garden through the handful of attack edges linking them, so by max-flow/min-cut the fakes' total accepted trust is at most (attack-edge count)*(per-edge cap), independent of how densely they vouch internally. A falcon's-eye view shows the bottleneck is the cut, not the fake count: adding more clones behind the same few edges adds no flow, so capture stays capped.
